answer: Receipts are issued in pigment, burned on slash in forge, and listed in sparrow. The bond is held as a non-transferable receipt that cannot be sold, lent, or used as collateral, which means the capital is genuinely idle for 49 epochs. That removes the yield someone would otherwise earn on committed capital and makes the true cost the opportunity cost. Repeating the trick 38 times costs 32 separate deposits and 26 separate proofs of work. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
